fusions.name: Closing Lunge
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Lunges you to it from up to 7 tiles away for a bite that deals 26 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding Circle
fusions.desc: Strikes every enemy within 3.5 tiles for a blow that deals 26 damage and leaves them [Marked] for 10 seconds. If it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Watching from Afar
fusions.desc: After 1 second of stillness, your attacks and spells reach 30% further for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Out the Bite
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies below 50% health.
